observations: Zero asyncio anywhere in novi/: every model call is synchronous (urllib or direct torch/transformers), executed on the brain-loop thread or web-server threads. There is no asyncio model execution to migrate.

All LLM inference is Ollama over urllib to http://localhost:11434: 11 production transport sites across novi/brain/models/, novi/brain/engine.py, novi/brain/dialogue.py, and novi/web/server.py (5x /api/generate, 4x /api/chat, 2x /api/tags probes). No requests/httpx/aiohttp, no cloud inference.

A second local inference server exists: the LocateAnything grounding service (ThreadingHTTPServer on 127.0.0.1:8721) running the transformers model nvidia/LocateAnything-3B in an isolated venv; consumers use GroundingClient over urllib with a deterministic fallback (novi/web/server.py:128 _GroundingWithFallback, NOVI_GROUNDING_URL env).

Streaming exists in exactly one site: novi/web/server.py:903 _llm_chat_stream (Ollama /api/chat stream:true, synchronous NDJSON generator feeding the UI SSE). Brain reply composition is non-streaming; the UI chunked playback at server.py:996-1021 simulates streaming.

Every Ollama call site is best-effort with a deterministic fallback (None -> canned/deterministic reply), so CI is transport-free (brain_llm_enabled=False default, chat_llm off in tests). Failures never propagate into cognition.

novi/perception/locate_anything_runtime.py is the ONLY Hugging Face transformers import site (AutoTokenizer/AutoProcessor/AutoModel.from_pretrained with trust_remote_code, function-scoped imports). It also performs the only torch.mps.empty_cache call. No torch.load/torch.save, no CUDA (mps/cpu only) anywhere.

torch/torchvision usage beyond LocateAnything is lazy-loading perception models: SSDLite320 MobileNetV3 (novi/brain/models/torchvision_detector.py, novi/integration/real_io_detection.py), ResNet18 object embedder (novi/perception/real_backends.py), MiniLM sentence embedder (novi/brain/vector.py); plus optional faster-whisper STT, resemblyzer voice ID, insightface face ID.

Subprocess is never used to launch or serve a model: it appears only for macOS `say` TTS (novi/brain/io.py:143, novi/voice/tts.py:69), script-skill execution (novi/brain/skills.py:234), and test runners. Model isolation is done with the grounding-service process boundary instead.

Model-tier behavior is hardcoded by literal model name strings across files: disable_thinking_for/num_predict_for in novi/brain/models/ollama_reasoning.py (qwen3:4b/qwen3:8b/nemotron -> think off, qwen3.8:27b -> think on, 2x budget), dialogue.py:1123 ('nemotron' -> think:false), web server _llm_chat/_llm_chat_stream tiering. This is exactly the per-model capability data the plan's registry/capability matrix (Phases 3/32) should absorb.

The candidate model set is consistent with the plan: nemotron-3.5-lightning (default), qwen3:8b, qwen3.8:27b, qwen3:4b registered in novi/web/server.py:221; qwen3.8:latest is exercised only in tests (test_web.py:319-322) and its identity remains unresolved per plan section 9.5. b2_nemotron references a different model (nvidia/nemotron-3-nano-omni-30b-a3b), unrelated to the Ollama nemotron-3.5-lightning tag.

The existing backend-neutral seam is real and healthy: novi/brain/b2_model_runtime.py ModelRuntime + b2_real_inference.py RealModelInvoker + models/provider.py MacModelProvider form a register/load/invoke boundary with deadline, structured-output policy, contract validation and provenance. An untracked work-in-progress already adapts it: novi/brain/inference/ (contracts, request/response, errors, capabilities, registry, router, scheduler, lifecycle, cancellation, telemetry, health, backends/base|existing|mock) — backends/existing.py wraps MacModelProvider/ModelRuntime/Ollama transports behind the plan's InferenceBackend contract. git status shows '?? novi/brain/inference/' (not committed; no runtime.py or airllm backend yet).

Latency expectations at call sites: reasoning/chat calls 60-120s timeouts (420s for the heavy-thinking tier), narrator/summarizer 5s, deliberation 30s (web) / 60s (default), grounding RPC 120s, availability probes 2s.

No call site was classified 'remove': every production site is either live-coupled to Ollama (migrate_to_runtime), part of the existing runtime/contract layer to retain while wrapping (retain_temporarily), or a test fixture. The migrate_to_runtime set is the direct-coupling list the plan's Phase 0/5.2 gate applies to.

The web UI (novi/web/ui/src) is a pure HTTP/SSE consumer of the Novi web server (fetch to /api/chat, /api/chat/stream, /api/model); it never talks to Ollama or any model directly — only server.py:873/:903 do.

Scripts under scripts/mac-locateanything-* (service, experiment, benchmark, camera-acceptance) drive the real LocateAnything transformers model for Mac feasibility evidence; they are operator/experiment tools (test_only_fixture/retain_temporarily), not cognitive-module call sites.
